Title: EVT-OP-033: Does d-separation characterize extremal conditional independence?
Labels: open-problem, area:multivariate, type:research, difficulty:medium, status:research

**Status in the survey:** OPEN-EXPLICIT (2024); no resolution found. The survey did not check the author list.

## Source and quote
Engelke, Hentschel et al., *Graphical models for multivariate extremes*, arXiv:2402.02187:

> On the other hand, it is still unknown whether $d$ -separation fully characterizes extremal conditional independence or if it is strictly stronger.

The quote was extracted from the source text, with symbols flattened; check it against the published version before citing.

## Why it matters
Max-linear Bayesian networks are fitted to river networks and financial contagion. Which independences the graph encodes decides what a fitted graph means.

## What the library already has
Spectral measures and exponent functions of simple max-stable vectors, and `IsSimpleMaxStable.existsUnique_hasSpectralMeasure`. Discrete spectral measures give max-linear models.

## What is missing
Extremal conditional independence, d-separation and max-linear models on directed graphs.
